ISerializeChunk 是只读二元组：text 携带 string，bytes 携带 Uint8Array，value 携带已经完成的 unknown 业务对象。text/bytes 是可传输的文本/字节；value 没有隐含文本或字节形式。ISerializeChunkKind 为三个标签的联合类型。

ISerializeParser 要求 name、encode(value, context)、decode(chunk, context)，可选 dispose()。encode 可返回单段、Promise 单段、同步 Iterable 或 AsyncIterable；decode 返回值或 Promise。上述四种编码结果的联合类型是 ISerializeOutput。同步 parser 直接返回值即可，无需自己制造 Promise。ISerializeContext 含组合 signal 和定位字符串 context；名称不是旧 source，避免与错误来源混淆。ISerializePlugin 是 { type, parser }，把格式标签与实现绑定。

registry.encode 将一次 parser 输出收集为一个 chunk：全 text 拼文本；出现 bytes 就用 encoder 将 text 转为字节再合并；value 必须独占，混入任何其他段均为 INVALID_CHUNK；零段为 ENCODE_FAILED。逐段接纳会记录真实 chunkIndex 与 bytesConsumed；每次消费前检查取消。异步迭代失败会调用 iterator.return 清理，次要清理错误交 report，不覆盖主错误。
isChunkShape 仅区分单段与段容器：必须是长度为 2 的数组，首项是字符串。它不检查标签是否合法，后续校验才区分 unknown tag、text 数据非字符串、bytes 数据非真正 Uint8Array 等错误。公开边界取得的 tuple 字段需要作为一次快照使用，不应靠后续反复读取来重解释输入。

根入口常量与值联合复用规范值：SerializeChunkKind/ISerializeChunkKind 为 text/bytes/value；SerializeOutput/ISerializeOutputFormat 为 text/structured/binary；SerializeTextFormat/ISerializeTextFormat 为 json/yaml/toml；SerializePhase/ISerializePhase 为 encode/decode；SerializeCleanupPolicy/ISerializeCleanupPolicy 为 throw/report；SerializeCleanupKind/ISerializeCleanupKind 为 cleanup-error/drain-timeout；SerializePluginType/ISerializePluginType 为 json。这些标签不发出 instrumentation 事件，也不是新增错误码。

createSerializeRegistry(plugins, options?) 要求非空插件数组，第一项 type 为 primaryType。每个 type 必须是长度 1–64 的 ASCII token，首位字母/数字，其余可含点、下划线、连字符；SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN 为 /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i，assertSerializeType 非法时抛 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION。写入 HTML 或存档信封时仍需正确转义，token 校验不能代替输出转义。

插件 type 不能重复；parser 必须有可调用 encode/decode，dispose 提供时也必须可调用。空表、重复 type 是 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION，结构非法是 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION。插件列表、字段和方法在接管前完成准入快照，原对象后续改写不能替换已接纳的行为；准入失败不调用 parser 或其 dispose，也没有半接管后回滚的义务。options 省略为空对象，提供时必须为对象或函数。

blocks.text: options getter、scheduler、Encoding 能力的读取和调用按准入边界保留原始 cause；不能让裸访问器失败替代本包错误身份。scheduler.schedule(callback, delayMs) 返回有 cancel()、可选 unref() 的任务；core 使用 timer 时不直接读取全局计时器。

primaryType 是第一项格式；types 是登记顺序的只读名字列表；has(type) 查询是否登记。encode(value, options?) 和 decode(chunk, options?) 返回 Promise。操作 options.type 默认 primaryType，context 默认 anonymous，signal 默认未提供；传给 parser 的 context.signal 包含调用方与内部 closing 信号，谁先被观察为取消就采用谁。未知格式为 CODEC_NOT_FOUND，错误 context 固定 registry。ISerializeRegistry 与 ISerializeRegistryOptions 分别表示返回接口和构造选项。
decode 的准入先看是否关闭，再找格式，最后校验 chunk，因此分别优先产生 REGISTRY_DISPOSED、CODEC_NOT_FOUND、INVALID_CHUNK。关闭后的调用失败是带码原生 Error，不必是 SerializeCodecError。即使 parser 忽略 signal，框架也会在取消时提前拒绝并丢弃晚到结果，不代表底层同步计算或外部任务被强制终止。
close() 同步且幂等：拒绝新请求并取消当前操作，但不释放 parser。dispose(options?) 先 close，再排空，随后逐个 await parser.dispose；共享一个 parser 的多个 type 只释放一次。重复 dispose 返回第一次的同一 Promise。

dispose 的唯一可选字段 deadlineAt 默认 undefined，提供时必须是 scheduler.now 时间域的有限绝对时间。首次接纳调用固定截止值；后续调用不能修改。截止只限制 drain，不是 parser cleanup 的硬超时。截止已过或等待期间到期时可触发 { kind: 'drain-timeout', source, deadlineAt, pendingCount }，随后继续释放。pendingCount 可以为 0；onDrainTimeout 是诊断，不是新的错误码。ISerializeTimeoutDiagnostic 描述该事件；ISerializeCleanupError 描述清理失败事件。
取消 listener 登记后会立即重查信号，不依赖宿主重放事件；进入操作时已经关闭的内部信号优先。取消原因保持 cause 身份，读取信号失败为 INVALID_OPTION。公开 Promise 可及时取消，底层 parser task 仍由 registry 跟踪；close 本身不等待它。

cleanup.policy 为 throw 时，清理失败成为 dispose 的拒绝；已有 primary 时，次要失败追加到 errors，必要时通过 AggregateError 保留全部原因。report 策略发出 { kind: 'cleanup-error', source, error } 并保持正常结算。report/onDrainTimeout 自身异常被限制在诊断路径，不能改写已公开结果；report 自身失败交 utils 宿主异常通路。底层 detached task 的迟到失败也要观察，不重新加入已关闭的生命周期；未配置 report 保持既有 no-op。

jsonParser(options?) 返回 name=json 的 ISerializeParser；jsonPlugin(options?) 返回 type=json 的插件。IJsonPluginOptions 的 replacer、reviver、space 默认未提供，分别交 JSON.stringify、JSON.parse 和缩进；decoder 默认在字节解码时使用宿主 TextDecoder。配置缺省为空对象，普通 JSON 语义并不等于 portable 严格校验。

encode 产出 text；stringify 返回 undefined 时拒绝，原生编码失败标 ENCODE_FAILED。decode 的 value 直接返回原对象；text 直接 parse；bytes 经 decoder 后 parse，缺失能力为 ENV_UNSUPPORTED，解析失败标 DECODE_FAILED。独立 parser 也有错误身份；可附码原生错误保留实例、类型和 stack，冲突或不可扩展时用 coded TypeError wrapper 的 cause 保留原错。

chunkToText(chunk, decoder) 与 chunkToBytes(chunk, encoder) 的 Encoding 参数必填。前者 text 原样返回，bytes 解码；后者 text 编码，bytes 返回 slice 副本，不共享原数组。value 均拒绝为 TypeError/INVALID_CHUNK。转换器自身抛错按 decode/encode 标注，错误原因不丢失。

sliceByFrameBudget(items, options) 是 async generator，items 为只读数组，options 和 scheduler 必填，没有 core 全局 timer 默认值。它在 yield 后恢复时观察消费者处理该片的耗时，用 targetMs / max(elapsed, 0.05) 估计下一片大小，与当前值取中点，再限制到 minItems/maxItems；这是协作式切片，不保证任何设备上的帧率。IFrameBudgetOptions 是切片选项，IEncodeStreamOptions 增加编码选项，ICollectStreamOptions 是收集策略；自定义 yieldTo 负责自己的 Promise 与取消，不能假定其等待总能及时中断。

blocks.text: encodeStream(registry, items, options) 使用同一切片选项，另加 type（默认 registry 主格式）、context（默认 stream）、maxInFlight（默认 1，必须为正安全整数）。每片单独调用 registry.encode，按输入顺序 yield，maxInFlight 限制同时在途的编码。单个 JSON 数组片段不因相邻而成为一个完整 JSON 文档；需要还原整批时逐片 decode，再在业务层合并数组。

decodeStream(registry, chunks, options?) 接受同步或异步 chunk iterable，options 默认空对象，type 默认 registry 主格式，context 默认 stream，signal 默认未提供；逐片 decode 并 yield，不整体拼装。两种 stream 错误分别包装 ENCODE_FAILED/DECODE_FAILED，chunkIndex 是外层片序，bytesConsumed 为 0，原内层错误留在 cause。外层位置与单次 parser 的内部段号不同。
流入口先读取选项快照，再取得 iterator；失败不能被误报成迭代失败。取消在异步边界后仍需复查，源/生成器提前结束时要结束所属 iterator；次要 return 失败走报告，不覆盖主错。encodeStream 提前 break 时取消自己创建的操作并观察剩余在途任务，不等待不合作的 parser 无限挂起；parser drain 仍由 registry.dispose 管理。

collectStream(chunks, encoder?, options?) 只适合确实需要一整块结果的消费者，不能免除全量驻留。options.signal 默认未提供，empty 默认 text（空流返回 ['text', '']），另值 reject；context 默认 stream。全 text 用 join 拼接；单个 bytes 可以直接返回；多个 chunk 且含 bytes（即使全 bytes）须显式传 encoder，否则 ENV_UNSUPPORTED，core 不读取全局 TextEncoder。value 一律 INVALID_CHUNK。坏 tuple 保留 chunkIndex/累计 bytesConsumed，源迭代失败标 ENCODE_FAILED；Abort 保留取消身份，相关 iterator 清理仍受边界约束。

sections.heading: Base64 与二进制文本通道

blocks.text: bytesToBase64(Uint8Array) 返回完整 RFC 4648 Base64；base64ToBytes(string) 要求规范填充、有效末尾未用位，失败为 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION，cause 保留 utils 原始 INVALID_ENCODING。它不同于 portable tag 使用的不填充 base64url。

streamBase64Chunks(bytes) 为同步惰性 Generator，逐块 yield 而不拼完整字符串，空输入零块。内部块长 32763 字节，是 3 的倍数，避免片间填充破坏编码；没有公开块长选项。算法来自 utils/bytes，不构造整份 binary string，也不调用 btoa/atob。最终必须得到单一字符串时用 bytesToBase64；能直接传字节的通道无需先转 Base64。4/3 的体积变化是编码格式的性质，不是性能测量。

`ICodec<TValue, TEncoded, TId, TVersion>` 含只读 id、version、encodedType、encode、decode；后两项是函数属性，保留严格参数方差。TId 默认 string、TVersion 默认 number。encodedType 只能 unknown/string/uint8array，codec 的同步函数不等于 registry 的异步 parser。identityCodec 固定 id=identity、version=1、encodedType=unknown，encode/decode 原样返回同一值及具体类型；旧 alias 和无版本 identity 子入口已删除。

defineJsonCodec、defineMessagePackCodec、defineCBORCodec 的 options.version 必填，为正安全整数；工厂返回冻结 codec，id 分别为 json、message-pack、cbor，输出分别为 string、Uint8Array、Uint8Array。三者先做同一 portable 投影/校验；JSON、集合 JSON、CBOR 与 MessagePack 按 Object.keys 属性枚举顺序投影，不做比较排序，getter 每次按该顺序读取；MessagePack 不使用扩展；CBOR 关闭 records 和宿主扩展，解码 bigint 整数仅在可精确表示为安全整数时转 number，否则拒绝。

defineProtobufCodec 的 options 必含 version、schema、binding。schema.id 符合 /^[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$/u，schema.version 为正安全整数，与 codec.version 独立；binding 必须为生成的 Buf DescMessage，不能传自定义 encode/decode hook。返回冻结 schema 身份，业务值为 `MessageShape<TBinding>`；encodedType=uint8array，encode/decode 验证真实 Uint8Array，并保留 Buf 原错误原因。格式工厂自身不提供存储或网络信封。

ICodecValue 的静态域为 null、boolean、number、string、嵌套只读数组和记录；数值仍需运行时有限性检查。normalizeCodecFailure(error, code, message) 原样保留本包已标注 Error，其他失败包装为 TypeError 并保留 cause；CodecErrorText 持有稳定版本、schema、编解码和 portable 拒绝文案。

sections.heading: Portable 默认规则与可复用 walker

blocks.text: toPortableValue(value, active?) 返回旧中间投影，不等于最终断言：普通对象按 Object.keys 属性枚举顺序逐项读取并递归，得到可变 ordinary 对象，不冻结；Uint8Array 变成 { $rpc: 'bytes', base64url }。继承/非枚举/symbol 字段不进入记录投影，getter 可能执行，重复兄弟引用各复制一次；环只按当前祖先路径判断。投影阶段可暂存 undefined/NaN 等中间值，格式 codec 最终校验才拒绝。

assertPortableValue(value, active?) 返回 void，asCodecValue(value) 验证后返回同一 ICodecValue 视图；不复制或冻结。默认 decoded profile 拒绝非有限数、undefined、函数、symbol、bigint、Date/Map/Set、非法数组和 native bytes；认可的 bytes tag 保留既有字符集规则，不冒称额外协议的 canonical 位校验。默认深度不限。ArrayBuffer/class 等旧投影行为不应被误称为通用安全快照。

createPortableWalker(strategy) 从根或 codec 导入，在模块/owner 作用域创建一次并复用。每次 walk(value, active?, initialDepth?, beforeNativeBinary?) 返回 { value, byteUpperBound, hasBinary }；walk.value 用同一递归，只返回值。active 为当前祖先 Set，缺省按本次需要建立并在结束后释放图引用；initialDepth 默认 0，根深度 0，大于 maxDepth 才拒绝。binary guard 是本次调用的可选边界，不是全局注册。

rows: 必填；返回 primitive 或 { value, violation? }，保留延迟失败优先级。
必填；返回 inline base64url string、借用 Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer，或 undefined 继续容器准入。
native 结果必需的 intrinsic 长度读取器，不能信任 caller shadow getter。
必填；返回 { entries, output?, tag?, hasBinary?, validate? } 或 undefined；entries 可预捕获或惰性读取，未给 output 时仅校验。
可选；返回原数组或 { value, length?, violation? }，默认沿 map，捕获 length 可免重读。
arrayValue(value, ownedVisit, childDepth, ancestors, guard, bounds, context)
与 array 互斥，直接返回原投影，用 visit 保持词法遍历归属，不能自己另写递归。
默认无限制，由策略决定预算。
可选，在访问子值前校验保留字段。
可选；默认 defineProperty，确保 own `__proto__` 不改原型。
可选，可冻结容器；native leaf 不复制、不冻结、不调用 finish。
必填，抛调用方已拥有的 coded 原生错误，保留原始 cause 和 stack。

blocks.text: context 提供 reject、isAncestor、isUint8Array、bytesToBase64url、isCanonicalBase64url 及可选 beforeNativeBinary。通用原因有 depth/cycle/access/ancestor，其余由策略拥有。context 只供同步 hook 使用；已分类错误保持身份，应用回调异常交 violation('access', original)，祖先 Set 自身失败保持原边界。
byteUpperBound 是 JSON UTF-8 保守上界，不是实际长度：每 UTF-16 单元最多 6 个转义字节、数值最多 32 字节，加容器标点与 bytes tag。值、字节上界和 hasBinary 同次遍历融合，不再扫描输入；native 长度由策略给出，不能把这个数当完整共享 backing/offset 协议预算。

IPortableBinaryResult 是 string/Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer 的非包装联合。native 对象保留 exact identity，不复制或冻结；finish 的第二参数仅证明 native descendant，hasBinary 还包含 inline tags，不能据此授予某协议 native 权限。重入 getter 会恢复外层会计与活动路径，已完成调用不保留输入；value-only 数组路径不额外探测输出 length。

默认 JSON/MessagePack/CBOR 仍为 inline-only，保留原字节与失败优先级：先完成投影，再抛延迟校验错误，较晚 getter 失败仍可优先。RPC 的 null-prototype/freeze、父字段预捕获、深度 64、canonical tag 与协议身份由 rpc-contract 自己的策略拥有，serialize 不内置消费者 profile，也不拥有 manifest 或 native 协商。
emitOutput(value, format?) 同步返回完整文本，format 默认 json，另有 yaml/toml；JSON 复用 jsonParser，YAML/TOML 仅输出、不引入第三方运行时，也不是 registry parser。
输入只接受有限数、字符串、布尔、数组和 plain own-data 记录，JSON/YAML 允许 null。描述符准入拒绝可枚举访问器而不求值，也拒绝循环、稀疏数组、命名数组属性、可枚举 symbol、不支持的值与非普通原型。不会调用 toJSON、replacer 或业务 getter，失败不返回部分文本，诊断不回显输入。
TOML 只接受对象根，任意深度 null 和未配对 surrogate 都拒绝；键和字符串加引号，嵌套集合保持结构。负零输出 -0.0，不安全整数用浮点写法避免进入 TOML 整数域。错误为带 source/code 的原生 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION，读取失败保留原因。这个严格 own-data 输出规则与旧 portable 投影不同。

SerializeCodecError(message, details) 的 details 必含 code、type、phase、chunkIndex、bytesConsumed，可选 context、source、cause；source 默认 serialization，TCode 默认 ISerializeErrorCode，上层可用自己的 code 联合与 source 复用它。phase 为 encode/decode，cause 保留原对象。registry 编解码失败和原生构造/生命周期失败载体不同，统一按 (source, code) 判断，不能只靠 instanceof。

rows: ENCODE_FAILED：编码、空输出或流迭代失败；cause 保留原错。
INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。
ABORTED：协作式取消；可能为 SerializeCodecError 或 tagged 原生错误，取决于边界。
INVALID_OPTION：插件、版本、portable、scheduler、流选项、Base64 或输出准入非法。
ENV_UNSUPPORTED：Encoding 等必需宿主能力缺失。
TAG_MISSING：无标签输入缺少显式 untagged 读取器。
TAG_UNKNOWN：合法标签没有对应的登记版本。

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) 返回原错误并附只读 source/code，context 未提供保持未设；同身份重复附加幂等，context 仅补一次。冲突委托 utils，抛 (foundation.utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT)，原错误在 cause，不能静默改写身份。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

sections.heading: 在 JSON 中保留 Map 与 Set

blocks.text: 值含 Map 或 Set 时显式选集合 codec。它复用严格 JSON 的 portable 规则，增加递归集合，投影类实例的可枚举字段，拒绝非有限数字、undefined、Date 与循环引用。保留的 $rpc 记录须符合 bytes/map/set 的精确形状。集合按插入顺序遍历，使用内部槽及内建迭代器。字节解码后仍为 bytes 记录；旧集合元组按普通数据读取。
格式 codec 与公开 toPortableValue 都先枚举整数索引，再按字符串插入顺序输出，getter 遍历顺序相同。serialize 不负责键排序；需要规范顺序时，由消费者负责规范化。RPC owned 快照与普通对象、字节 JSON 路径均保持对象自身的 key 顺序；RPC 私有快照仍由原单遍遍历同时完成复制与字节上限计算，并跳过已经编码的二进制子树。

sections.id: 编码结果自带格式标签
sections.heading: 编码结果自带格式标签

blocks.text: 首项 codec 写新值，列表内各 id/version 读取自己的带标签载荷。可选 untagged 只读取原始旧数据。未知标签报 TAG_UNKNOWN；保留头部损坏报 TAG_INVALID，不回退。无标签文本若以 mgt1: 开头，也会当作有标签输入，即使它来自 untagged codec。

字符串载体前置 mgt1:<id>@<version>;。字节载体前置 00 4d 47 54、格式字节 01、两字节大端 UTF-8 标签长度与标签。unknown 载体返回带自有 $migaia.codec 和 value 的冻结对象，内层值不冻结。所有 codec 声明同一载体，外层身份为 tagged@1，与存储 envelope 版本独立。ICodecEncodedType、ITaggedCodecOptions、ITaggedEncoded、ITaggedValue 与 ITaggedCodec 保留载体及业务值推断。

sections.id: 编码设置后再读回原值
sections.heading: 编码设置后再读回原值

blocks.text: 设置页面需要生成可保存的文本，再次打开时还要走同一条解码路径。
把字符串化和解析散在调用方，会把业务绑定到一种格式，也没有统一的地方管理格式选择和解析器清理。
把 `jsonPlugin()` 登记到序列化注册表，首个插件决定默认写入格式。`encode()` 返回带类型的片段，`decode()` 负责读回；文本通道用 `chunkToText()` 取得载荷，结束时释放注册表。

插件列表必填，本例只有 jsonPlugin()，因此 primaryType 为 json。registry options 省略，scheduler 默认 systemScheduler，encoder/decoder 默认宿主 Encoding 能力，cleanup 默认 throw，两个诊断口默认 no-op。encode/decode 的 type 默认主格式、context 默认 anonymous、signal 省略；chunkToText 的第二参数 TextDecoder 必填。theme 是业务数据，不是配置字段。
输出：
依次输出 `格式: json`、`文本: {"theme":"dark"}`、`主题: dark`。
同一个已登记解析器完成编码和解码。片段只是 `[kind, payload]`，不是保存格式标签的存储封套；多格式共存时，应把 `primaryType` 另存到数据旁。解析器清理由注册表持有，结束后必须释放。

sections.id: 默认写新格式-按已保存标签读旧格式
sections.heading: 默认写新格式，按已保存标签读旧格式

blocks.text: 新设置不应继续保存本地预览缓存，但已保存的设置仍带旧格式标签，必须可以读回。
直接替换唯一解析器，可能让旧记录再也无法读取；根据 `[kind, payload]` 猜格式也不可靠，因为片段不包含应用的格式标签。
把新解析器放在登记列表首位，并用旧标签保留旧解析器。新写入默认使用首个类型，读旧记录时把已保存的 `type` 显式传给 `decode()`。两版都使用 JSON，新写入器省略 `localCache`，旧读取器则把存档中的数字主题 0 还原成 `light`。

每项插件包含 type 和 parser；首项 json-v2 默认写入，json-v1 仅在 decode 的 type 指定时选择。新 parser 的 replacer 接收 key/value，遇到 localCache 返回 undefined；旧 parser 的 reviver 把 theme 的数字 0 转回 light，证明实际选用了旧读取器。其余 space/decoder 省略。saved.type 由业务另存，chunk 的 text 标签只说明载荷形态，不说明格式版本。
输出：

blocks.code:
新格式: json-v2
新文本: {"theme":"dark"}
旧主题: light
旧缓存: legacy

blocks.text: 依次输出 `新格式: json-v2`、`新文本: {"theme":"dark"}`、`旧主题: light`、`旧缓存: legacy`。
默认写入器改变了，旧读取器仍在。显式传入已保存的旧标签，会选到其还原器，把存档中的 0 变成 `light`；误用新读取器则仍会得到 0。登记类型字符串属于应用封套元数据，与 codec 工厂的 `version` 字段是两种契约。JSON 插件遵循原生替换器和还原器行为，不使用更严格的 portable codec 规则。

sections.id: 拒绝非有限计数-避免悄悄存成-null
sections.heading: 拒绝非有限计数，避免悄悄存成 null

blocks.text: 包含 `NaN` 的计量结果被存成了 `null`，之后读取时无法区分输入无效与有意清空。
原生 JSON 会把非有限数字替换为 null，TypeScript 的 number 类型本身又不会拒绝 `NaN`，因此原值可能在没有报错的情况下丢失。
用 `defineJsonCodec({ version: 1 })` 创建 JSON codec，经由 portable 规则编码；portable 是供不同格式共同使用的受限数据域。有限数字可通过，非有限数字会以 `INVALID_OPTION` 失败，不会被悄悄替换。
defineJsonCodec 的 options.version 必填，本例为 1，允许正安全整数；返回 id=json、encodedType=string 的 codec。count 的 number 类型仍可能包含 NaN，portable 运行时规则会拒绝它。工厂 version 不自动写进编码文本。
输出：
依次输出 `有限值: {"count":2}`、`原生 JSON: {"count":null}`、`portable 拒绝: INVALID_OPTION`。
codec 拒绝了这次会丢失标量含义的转换。必填版本为正安全整数，是 codec 自身的元数据，不会自动嵌入返回字符串。这套严格规则与有意保留原生 JSON 行为的 `jsonPlugin()` 不同。

sections.id: 把同一份配置导出为三种文本格式
sections.heading: 把同一份配置导出为三种文本格式

blocks.text: 配置下载需要 JSON、YAML 和 TOML，分别拼接文本时，对输入值的接受规则不同，同一份设置可能得到不一致的内容。
手写格式化会把值校验、引号转义和嵌套集合语法混在一起，增加格式时容易顺带改变保留哪些字段或怎样转义字符串。
把配置交给 `emitOutput()`，用 `SerializeTextFormat` 选择格式。三种格式共用普通数据接纳规则，每次调用都会先对输入校验并投影，再输出所选格式；省略格式时使用 JSON。
emitOutput 的第一个参数是普通自有数据，第二个 format 可省略，默认 json；SerializeTextFormat.yaml/toml 分别选择另外两种输出。theme 和 retries 是业务字段。格式全集为 json/yaml/toml，YAML/TOML 只生成文本，不提供反向 parser。

blocks.code:
import { emitOutput, SerializeTextFormat } from '@migaia/serialize'

const settings = { theme: 'dark', retries: 2 }
console.log('JSON:', emitOutput(settings))
console.log('YAML:', emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.yaml))
console.log('TOML:\n' + emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.toml))

blocks.text: 输出：
依次输出 `JSON: {"theme":"dark","retries":2}`、`YAML: {"theme": "dark", "retries": 2}`，然后三行 `TOML:`、`"theme" = "dark"`、`"retries" = 2`。
三种输出保留了传入字段，YAML 使用合法的流式集合语法。这是文本生成工具，不是 YAML 或 TOML 解析器。TOML 要求根值为记录并拒绝 null，其余格式也会拒绝不支持的值，不会悄悄省略。

sections.id: 拒绝访问器字段-不执行其读取代码
sections.heading: 拒绝访问器字段，不执行其读取代码

blocks.text: 配置对象中出现了访问器属性，序列化读取它时可能暴露数据或执行额外工作。
普通复制或字符串化中的属性读取会执行 getter；读完以后再删字段，已经无法撤销执行或暴露。
需要普通数据导出边界时使用 `emitOutput()`。它先检查自有可枚举属性描述器，在执行 getter 前拒绝访问器，只有有效数据投影完成后才生成文本。
本例 options 没有额外配置，省略 format 仍为 json。token 是带 getter 的业务字段，拒绝发生在属性描述符检查阶段；reads 计数证明没有调用其读取逻辑。普通 Proxy 的描述符陷阱仍可能运行，不能把该保证扩大成不执行任何用户代码。
输出：

blocks.code:
拒绝: true INVALID_OPTION
getter 读取次数: 0

blocks.text: 依次输出 `拒绝: true INVALID_OPTION`、`getter 读取次数: 0`。
这个访问器在没有执行 getter 的情况下被拒绝，也没有返回部分字符串。边界接纳由支持的标量及数据值组成的普通记录或稠密数组，不是任意对象序列化器，检查描述器时也不承诺避开 Proxy 陷阱。

sections.id: 逐片处理数组-不把多个-json-文档直接拼接
sections.heading: 逐片处理数组，不把多个 JSON 文档直接拼接

blocks.text: 大数组导出先编码成完整字符串，第一片数据能被处理前，就必须在内存里保留整份编码文档。
只把数组分片还不够；之后直接拼接 JSON 字符串，会把 `[1,2]` 和 `[3,4]` 变成两个相邻文档，而不是一个 JSON 数组。接收方必须把每片当作独立帧处理。
这个独立示例直接导入调度器，运行前应同时安装 `@migaia/serialize` 和 `@migaia/utils`。向 `encodeStream()` 传入注册表和调度器，逐个消费产生的片段。示例把分片上下限固定为两项，`maxInFlight: 1` 等待每片编码结束后才接纳下一片。

encodeStream 必填 registry、items、options.scheduler。本例 systemScheduler 提供 now/schedule，minItems/maxItems/initialItems 都是 2，maxInFlight 为 1。省略 targetMs 为 8，type 为主格式，context 为 stream，signal 不提供，yieldTo 使用 scheduler 的零延时任务。最后不足两项的片仍正常输出，结束时 finally 释放 registry。
本例直接导入 @migaia/utils/scheduler，请在消费项目显式安装该依赖：

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/utils

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
独立片段: [1,2]
独立片段: [3,4]
独立片段: [5]

blocks.text: 每个片段都包含一份独立编码的切片，按输入顺序交付，应按独立帧消费；此 API 不拼装单份文档，也不把各片变成一个连续 JSON 数组。`maxInFlight` 默认 1，调大可重叠请求，但会保留更多在途数据；消费方提前退出会取消排队操作，不会强行中断解析器代码。
本包负责值、分段协议、格式与编解码生命周期，不实现存储、Worker、HTTP 或 SSR 宿主。根入口聚合 core、plugins、registry，并提供格式常量、emitOutput、createPortableWalker 及 codec 相关类型。常见协议入口如下。

rows: chunk/parser/context/registry 契约、SerializeCodecError、错误工具、Base64、流式工具与相关类型。

ISerializeChunk 是只读二元组：text 携带 string，bytes 携带 Uint8Array，value 携带已经完成的 unknown 业务对象。text/bytes 是可传输的文本/字节；value 没有隐含文本或字节形式。ISerializeChunkKind 为三个标签的联合类型。

ISerializeParser 要求 name、encode(value, context)、decode(chunk, context)，可选 dispose()。encode 可返回单段、Promise 单段、同步 Iterable 或 AsyncIterable；decode 返回值或 Promise。上述四种编码结果的联合类型是 ISerializeOutput。同步 parser 直接返回值即可，无需自己制造 Promise。ISerializeContext 含组合 signal 和定位字符串 context；名称不是旧 source，避免与错误来源混淆。ISerializePlugin 是 { type, parser }，把格式标签与实现绑定。

registry.encode 将一次 parser 输出收集为一个 chunk：全 text 拼文本；出现 bytes 就用 encoder 将 text 转为字节再合并；value 必须独占，混入任何其他段均为 INVALID_CHUNK；零段为 ENCODE_FAILED。逐段接纳会记录真实 chunkIndex 与 bytesConsumed；每次消费前检查取消。异步迭代失败会调用 iterator.return 清理，次要清理错误交 report，不覆盖主错误。
isChunkShape 仅区分单段与段容器：必须是长度为 2 的数组，首项是字符串。它不检查标签是否合法，后续校验才区分 unknown tag、text 数据非字符串、bytes 数据非真正 Uint8Array 等错误。公开边界取得的 tuple 字段需要作为一次快照使用，不应靠后续反复读取来重解释输入。

根入口常量与值联合复用规范值：SerializeChunkKind/ISerializeChunkKind 为 text/bytes/value；SerializeOutput/ISerializeOutputFormat 为 text/structured/binary；SerializeTextFormat/ISerializeTextFormat 为 json/yaml/toml；SerializePhase/ISerializePhase 为 encode/decode；SerializeCleanupPolicy/ISerializeCleanupPolicy 为 throw/report；SerializeCleanupKind/ISerializeCleanupKind 为 cleanup-error/drain-timeout；SerializePluginType/ISerializePluginType 为 json。这些标签不发出 instrumentation 事件，也不是新增错误码。

createSerializeRegistry(plugins, options?) 要求非空插件数组，第一项 type 为 primaryType。每个 type 必须是长度 1–64 的 ASCII token，首位字母/数字，其余可含点、下划线、连字符；SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN 为 /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i，assertSerializeType 非法时抛 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION。写入 HTML 或存档信封时仍需正确转义，token 校验不能代替输出转义。

插件 type 不能重复；parser 必须有可调用 encode/decode，dispose 提供时也必须可调用。空表、重复 type 是 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION，结构非法是 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION。插件列表、字段和方法在接管前完成准入快照，原对象后续改写不能替换已接纳的行为；准入失败不调用 parser 或其 dispose，也没有半接管后回滚的义务。options 省略为空对象，提供时必须为对象或函数。

blocks.text: options getter、scheduler、Encoding 能力的读取和调用按准入边界保留原始 cause；不能让裸访问器失败替代本包错误身份。scheduler.schedule(callback, delayMs) 返回有 cancel()、可选 unref() 的任务；core 使用 timer 时不直接读取全局计时器。

primaryType 是第一项格式；types 是登记顺序的只读名字列表；has(type) 查询是否登记。encode(value, options?) 和 decode(chunk, options?) 返回 Promise。操作 options.type 默认 primaryType，context 默认 anonymous，signal 默认未提供；传给 parser 的 context.signal 包含调用方与内部 closing 信号，谁先被观察为取消就采用谁。未知格式为 CODEC_NOT_FOUND，错误 context 固定 registry。ISerializeRegistry 与 ISerializeRegistryOptions 分别表示返回接口和构造选项。
decode 的准入先看是否关闭，再找格式，最后校验 chunk，因此分别优先产生 REGISTRY_DISPOSED、CODEC_NOT_FOUND、INVALID_CHUNK。关闭后的调用失败是带码原生 Error，不必是 SerializeCodecError。即使 parser 忽略 signal，框架也会在取消时提前拒绝并丢弃晚到结果，不代表底层同步计算或外部任务被强制终止。
close() 同步且幂等：拒绝新请求并取消当前操作，但不释放 parser。dispose(options?) 先 close，再排空，随后逐个 await parser.dispose；共享一个 parser 的多个 type 只释放一次。重复 dispose 返回第一次的同一 Promise。

dispose 的唯一可选字段 deadlineAt 默认 undefined，提供时必须是 scheduler.now 时间域的有限绝对时间。首次接纳调用固定截止值；后续调用不能修改。截止只限制 drain，不是 parser cleanup 的硬超时。截止已过或等待期间到期时可触发 { kind: 'drain-timeout', source, deadlineAt, pendingCount }，随后继续释放。pendingCount 可以为 0；onDrainTimeout 是诊断，不是新的错误码。ISerializeTimeoutDiagnostic 描述该事件；ISerializeCleanupError 描述清理失败事件。
取消 listener 登记后会立即重查信号，不依赖宿主重放事件；进入操作时已经关闭的内部信号优先。取消原因保持 cause 身份，读取信号失败为 INVALID_OPTION。公开 Promise 可及时取消，底层 parser task 仍由 registry 跟踪；close 本身不等待它。

cleanup.policy 为 throw 时，清理失败成为 dispose 的拒绝；已有 primary 时，次要失败追加到 errors，必要时通过 AggregateError 保留全部原因。report 策略发出 { kind: 'cleanup-error', source, error } 并保持正常结算。report/onDrainTimeout 自身异常被限制在诊断路径，不能改写已公开结果；report 自身失败交 utils 宿主异常通路。底层 detached task 的迟到失败也要观察，不重新加入已关闭的生命周期；未配置 report 保持既有 no-op。

jsonParser(options?) 返回 name=json 的 ISerializeParser；jsonPlugin(options?) 返回 type=json 的插件。IJsonPluginOptions 的 replacer、reviver、space 默认未提供，分别交 JSON.stringify、JSON.parse 和缩进；decoder 默认在字节解码时使用宿主 TextDecoder。配置缺省为空对象，普通 JSON 语义并不等于 portable 严格校验。

encode 产出 text；stringify 返回 undefined 时拒绝，原生编码失败标 ENCODE_FAILED。decode 的 value 直接返回原对象；text 直接 parse；bytes 经 decoder 后 parse，缺失能力为 ENV_UNSUPPORTED，解析失败标 DECODE_FAILED。独立 parser 也有错误身份；可附码原生错误保留实例、类型和 stack，冲突或不可扩展时用 coded TypeError wrapper 的 cause 保留原错。

chunkToText(chunk, decoder) 与 chunkToBytes(chunk, encoder) 的 Encoding 参数必填。前者 text 原样返回，bytes 解码；后者 text 编码，bytes 返回 slice 副本，不共享原数组。value 均拒绝为 TypeError/INVALID_CHUNK。转换器自身抛错按 decode/encode 标注，错误原因不丢失。

sliceByFrameBudget(items, options) 是 async generator，items 为只读数组，options 和 scheduler 必填，没有 core 全局 timer 默认值。它在 yield 后恢复时观察消费者处理该片的耗时，用 targetMs / max(elapsed, 0.05) 估计下一片大小，与当前值取中点，再限制到 minItems/maxItems；这是协作式切片，不保证任何设备上的帧率。IFrameBudgetOptions 是切片选项，IEncodeStreamOptions 增加编码选项，ICollectStreamOptions 是收集策略；自定义 yieldTo 负责自己的 Promise 与取消，不能假定其等待总能及时中断。

blocks.text: encodeStream(registry, items, options) 使用同一切片选项，另加 type（默认 registry 主格式）、context（默认 stream）、maxInFlight（默认 1，必须为正安全整数）。每片单独调用 registry.encode，按输入顺序 yield，maxInFlight 限制同时在途的编码。单个 JSON 数组片段不因相邻而成为一个完整 JSON 文档；需要还原整批时逐片 decode，再在业务层合并数组。

decodeStream(registry, chunks, options?) 接受同步或异步 chunk iterable，options 默认空对象，type 默认 registry 主格式，context 默认 stream，signal 默认未提供；逐片 decode 并 yield，不整体拼装。两种 stream 错误分别包装 ENCODE_FAILED/DECODE_FAILED，chunkIndex 是外层片序，bytesConsumed 为 0，原内层错误留在 cause。外层位置与单次 parser 的内部段号不同。
流入口先读取选项快照，再取得 iterator；失败不能被误报成迭代失败。取消在异步边界后仍需复查，源/生成器提前结束时要结束所属 iterator；次要 return 失败走报告，不覆盖主错。encodeStream 提前 break 时取消自己创建的操作并观察剩余在途任务，不等待不合作的 parser 无限挂起；parser drain 仍由 registry.dispose 管理。

collectStream(chunks, encoder?, options?) 只适合确实需要一整块结果的消费者，不能免除全量驻留。options.signal 默认未提供，empty 默认 text（空流返回 ['text', '']），另值 reject；context 默认 stream。全 text 用 join 拼接；单个 bytes 可以直接返回；多个 chunk 且含 bytes（即使全 bytes）须显式传 encoder，否则 ENV_UNSUPPORTED，core 不读取全局 TextEncoder。value 一律 INVALID_CHUNK。坏 tuple 保留 chunkIndex/累计 bytesConsumed，源迭代失败标 ENCODE_FAILED；Abort 保留取消身份，相关 iterator 清理仍受边界约束。

sections.heading: Base64 与二进制文本通道

blocks.text: bytesToBase64(Uint8Array) 返回完整 RFC 4648 Base64；base64ToBytes(string) 要求规范填充、有效末尾未用位，失败为 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION，cause 保留 utils 原始 INVALID_ENCODING。它不同于 portable tag 使用的不填充 base64url。

streamBase64Chunks(bytes) 为同步惰性 Generator，逐块 yield 而不拼完整字符串，空输入零块。内部块长 32763 字节，是 3 的倍数，避免片间填充破坏编码；没有公开块长选项。算法来自 utils/bytes，不构造整份 binary string，也不调用 btoa/atob。最终必须得到单一字符串时用 bytesToBase64；能直接传字节的通道无需先转 Base64。4/3 的体积变化是编码格式的性质，不是性能测量。

`ICodec<TValue, TEncoded, TId, TVersion>` 含只读 id、version、encodedType、encode、decode；后两项是函数属性，保留严格参数方差。TId 默认 string、TVersion 默认 number。encodedType 只能 unknown/string/uint8array，codec 的同步函数不等于 registry 的异步 parser。identityCodec 固定 id=identity、version=1、encodedType=unknown，encode/decode 原样返回同一值及具体类型；旧 alias 和无版本 identity 子入口已删除。

defineJsonCodec、defineMessagePackCodec、defineCBORCodec 的 options.version 必填，为正安全整数；工厂返回冻结 codec，id 分别为 json、message-pack、cbor，输出分别为 string、Uint8Array、Uint8Array。三者先做同一 portable 投影/校验；JSON、集合 JSON、CBOR 与 MessagePack 按 Object.keys 属性枚举顺序投影，不做比较排序，getter 每次按该顺序读取；MessagePack 不使用扩展；CBOR 关闭 records 和宿主扩展，解码 bigint 整数仅在可精确表示为安全整数时转 number，否则拒绝。

defineProtobufCodec 的 options 必含 version、schema、binding。schema.id 符合 /^[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$/u，schema.version 为正安全整数，与 codec.version 独立；binding 必须为生成的 Buf DescMessage，不能传自定义 encode/decode hook。返回冻结 schema 身份，业务值为 `MessageShape<TBinding>`；encodedType=uint8array，encode/decode 验证真实 Uint8Array，并保留 Buf 原错误原因。格式工厂自身不提供存储或网络信封。

ICodecValue 的静态域为 null、boolean、number、string、嵌套只读数组和记录；数值仍需运行时有限性检查。normalizeCodecFailure(error, code, message) 原样保留本包已标注 Error，其他失败包装为 TypeError 并保留 cause；CodecErrorText 持有稳定版本、schema、编解码和 portable 拒绝文案。

sections.heading: Portable 默认规则与可复用 walker

blocks.text: toPortableValue(value, active?) 返回旧中间投影，不等于最终断言：普通对象按 Object.keys 属性枚举顺序逐项读取并递归，得到可变 ordinary 对象，不冻结；Uint8Array 变成 { $rpc: 'bytes', base64url }。继承/非枚举/symbol 字段不进入记录投影，getter 可能执行，重复兄弟引用各复制一次；环只按当前祖先路径判断。投影阶段可暂存 undefined/NaN 等中间值，格式 codec 最终校验才拒绝。

assertPortableValue(value, active?) 返回 void，asCodecValue(value) 验证后返回同一 ICodecValue 视图；不复制或冻结。默认 decoded profile 拒绝非有限数、undefined、函数、symbol、bigint、Date/Map/Set、非法数组和 native bytes；认可的 bytes tag 保留既有字符集规则，不冒称额外协议的 canonical 位校验。默认深度不限。ArrayBuffer/class 等旧投影行为不应被误称为通用安全快照。

createPortableWalker(strategy) 从根或 codec 导入，在模块/owner 作用域创建一次并复用。每次 walk(value, active?, initialDepth?, beforeNativeBinary?) 返回 { value, byteUpperBound, hasBinary }；walk.value 用同一递归，只返回值。active 为当前祖先 Set，缺省按本次需要建立并在结束后释放图引用；initialDepth 默认 0，根深度 0，大于 maxDepth 才拒绝。binary guard 是本次调用的可选边界，不是全局注册。

默认 JSON/MessagePack/CBOR 仍为 inline-only，保留原字节与失败优先级：先完成投影，再抛延迟校验错误，较晚 getter 失败仍可优先。RPC 的 null-prototype/freeze、父字段预捕获、深度 64、canonical tag 与协议身份由 rpc-contract 自己的策略拥有，serialize 不内置消费者 profile，也不拥有 manifest 或 native 协商。
emitOutput(value, format?) 同步返回完整文本，format 默认 json，另有 yaml/toml；JSON 复用 jsonParser，YAML/TOML 仅输出、不引入第三方运行时，也不是 registry parser。
输入只接受有限数、字符串、布尔、数组和 plain own-data 记录，JSON/YAML 允许 null。描述符准入拒绝可枚举访问器而不求值，也拒绝循环、稀疏数组、命名数组属性、可枚举 symbol、不支持的值与非普通原型。不会调用 toJSON、replacer 或业务 getter，失败不返回部分文本，诊断不回显输入。
TOML 只接受对象根，任意深度 null 和未配对 surrogate 都拒绝；键和字符串加引号，嵌套集合保持结构。负零输出 -0.0，不安全整数用浮点写法避免进入 TOML 整数域。错误为带 source/code 的原生 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION，读取失败保留原因。这个严格 own-data 输出规则与旧 portable 投影不同。

SerializeCodecError(message, details) 的 details 必含 code、type、phase、chunkIndex、bytesConsumed，可选 context、source、cause；source 默认 serialization，TCode 默认 ISerializeErrorCode，上层可用自己的 code 联合与 source 复用它。phase 为 encode/decode，cause 保留原对象。registry 编解码失败和原生构造/生命周期失败载体不同，统一按 (source, code) 判断，不能只靠 instanceof。

INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。

ISerializeChunk is a read-only pair: text carries a string, bytes carries Uint8Array, and value carries an already-completed unknown business value. Text and bytes have wire representations; value has no implicit text or byte form. ISerializeChunkKind is the union of those three labels.

ISerializeParser requires name, encode(value, context) and decode(chunk, context), with optional dispose(). Encode can return a chunk, a Promise of one chunk, a synchronous Iterable or an AsyncIterable. Decode returns a value or Promise. ISerializeOutput names that four-way encoding-output union. A synchronous parser can return directly without creating its own Promise. ISerializeContext contains the composed signal and diagnostic context string. The field is context rather than the old source name, keeping it distinct from error ownership. ISerializePlugin pairs type with parser.

registry.encode collects one parser output into one chunk. All-text chunks join as text. Once bytes appear, text is encoded and the output is assembled as bytes. A value chunk must be the only output: combining it with anything produces INVALID_CHUNK. Zero chunks produce ENCODE_FAILED. Incremental admission records actual chunkIndex and bytesConsumed and checks cancellation before consumption. Failed async iteration invokes iterator.return; secondary cleanup failures go to report without replacing the primary failure.

isChunkShape distinguishes a single chunk from a chunk container: it requires an array of length two whose first item is a string. It does not validate the label. Later validation distinguishes unknown labels, non-string text data and non-Uint8Array bytes. Boundary tuple fields are captured facts rather than values to reinterpret through repeated later reads.

Root constants and value unions use canonical domains: SerializeChunkKind/ISerializeChunkKind are text/bytes/value; SerializeOutput/ISerializeOutputFormat are text/structured/binary; SerializeTextFormat/ISerializeTextFormat are json/yaml/toml; SerializePhase/ISerializePhase are encode/decode; SerializeCleanupPolicy/ISerializeCleanupPolicy are throw/report; SerializeCleanupKind/ISerializeCleanupKind are cleanup-error/drain-timeout; SerializePluginType/ISerializePluginType are json. These labels neither emit instrumentation events nor introduce error codes.

createSerializeRegistry(plugins, options?) requires a nonempty plugin array. The first type becomes primaryType. Each type is an ASCII token of 1–64 characters, starting with a letter/digit and continuing with letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN is /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i. assertSerializeType rejects invalid tokens with RangeError/INVALID_OPTION. HTML and archive-envelope writers still need correct escaping; token validation is not output escaping.

Types must be unique. Each parser needs callable encode/decode, and dispose must be callable when supplied. Empty lists and duplicate types produce RangeError/INVALID_OPTION; malformed structures produce TypeError/INVALID_OPTION. Plugin lists, fields and methods are admitted before ownership transfers. Later input mutation cannot replace captured behavior. Failed admission invokes neither parser work nor parser cleanup and creates no partially owned parser set to roll back. Options default to an empty object and must be an object or function when supplied.

blocks.text: Option getters, scheduler operations and Encoding capability boundaries retain original causes rather than leaking unclassified property-access failures. scheduler.schedule(callback, delayMs) returns a task with cancel() and optional unref(). Core timer use does not read global timer functions.

primaryType is the first format. types lists registered types in order; has(type) checks membership. encode(value, options?) and decode(chunk, options?) return Promises. Operation type defaults to primaryType, context to anonymous and signal to omission. The parser receives a composition of caller and internal closing signals: the first observed cancellation wins. Unknown formats produce CODEC_NOT_FOUND with context fixed to registry. ISerializeRegistry names the returned interface and ISerializeRegistryOptions the construction options.

Decode first checks closing, then finds the requested format, then validates the chunk. The corresponding failure priority is REGISTRY_DISPOSED, CODEC_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_CHUNK. Closed-registry failures are tagged native Errors rather than necessarily SerializeCodecError instances. Even if a parser ignores signal, the framework rejects on cancellation and discards late output; that does not forcibly terminate synchronous computation or an external task.

close() is synchronous and idempotent: it denies new operations and aborts current ones without disposing parsers. dispose(options?) closes first, drains, then awaits each parser disposer. Sharing one parser under several types still disposes that instance once. Repeated dispose calls return the first Promise by identity.

The sole disposal option deadlineAt defaults to undefined. A supplied value must be a finite absolute time in the scheduler.now clock domain. The first admitted call fixes it; later calls cannot replace it. The deadline bounds draining, not parser cleanup. If the deadline is already past or expires while waiting, onDrainTimeout can receive { kind: 'drain-timeout', source, deadlineAt, pendingCount } before cleanup continues. pendingCount can be zero. A drain timeout is a diagnostic event rather than a new error code. ISerializeTimeoutDiagnostic describes it; ISerializeCleanupError describes cleanup-failure events.

Signal state is rechecked immediately after listener registration without depending on host event replay. An already-closing internal signal takes precedence at entry. Cancellation causes retain identity, and failing signal reads produce INVALID_OPTION. Public Promises can reject promptly while registry still tracks the underlying parser task; close itself does not wait.

With cleanup.policy throw, cleanup failure rejects disposal. If another primary failure already exists, secondary failures stay in errors, using AggregateError when necessary to retain all originals. Report policy emits { kind: 'cleanup-error', source, error } while allowing normal settlement. Diagnostic callback failures cannot rewrite an already-published result; report failures reach the shared utils host-error path. Detached task failures remain observed without rejoining a closed lifecycle. Omitting report retains the existing no-op policy.

jsonParser(options?) returns a parser named json; jsonPlugin(options?) returns a plugin of type json. IJsonPluginOptions replacer, reviver and space default to omission and feed JSON.stringify, JSON.parse and indentation respectively. The optional byte decoder falls back to the host TextDecoder. Options default to an empty object. Native JSON semantics are distinct from strict portable codec validation.

Encode returns text and rejects when stringify returns undefined. Native encoding failures receive ENCODE_FAILED. Decode returns value payloads unchanged, parses text directly and decodes bytes before parsing. Missing decoding capability produces ENV_UNSUPPORTED; parse failures receive DECODE_FAILED. A standalone parser also provides error identity. Annotatable native errors retain instance, type and stack; conflicting or non-extensible errors are retained as the cause of a coded TypeError wrapper.

chunkToText(chunk, decoder) and chunkToBytes(chunk, encoder) require their Encoding argument. The former returns text unchanged or decodes bytes. The latter encodes text or returns a slice copy of bytes, without sharing the original array. Both reject value chunks with TypeError/INVALID_CHUNK. Conversion failures are tagged at the decode/encode boundary with their causes retained.

sliceByFrameBudget(items, options) is an async generator over a read-only array. Options and scheduler are required; core provides no default global timer. On resumption after yield, it observes the consumer’s slice-processing time, estimates a next size using targetMs / max(elapsed, 0.05), averages that estimate with the current size and clamps to minItems/maxItems. This is cooperative slicing rather than a frame-rate guarantee on every device. IFrameBudgetOptions names slicing options, IEncodeStreamOptions adds encoding settings, and ICollectStreamOptions names collection policy. A custom yieldTo owns its Promise and cancellation behavior; its wait is not guaranteed to abort promptly.

blocks.text: encodeStream(registry, items, options) adds type (registry default format), context (stream) and maxInFlight (1, a positive safe integer) to those options. It calls registry.encode independently for each slice and yields in input order. maxInFlight bounds concurrent encoding requests. Adjacent JSON array slices are not one complete JSON document: decode frames separately and combine arrays in the application when that is the intended result.

decodeStream(registry, chunks, options?) accepts a synchronous or asynchronous chunk iterable. Options default to an empty object, type to the registry format, context to stream and signal to omission. It decodes and yields each frame without assembling the complete result. Stream encoding/decoding failures wrap ENCODE_FAILED/DECODE_FAILED with the outer frame index, bytesConsumed zero and the inner error on cause. That position differs from the parser’s internal chunk index.

Stream entry points capture options before acquiring an iterator, so admission failures are not mislabeled as iteration failures. Cancellation is rechecked across async boundaries. Early source/generator completion closes its owned iterator; secondary return failures are reported without replacing the primary failure. An early encodeStream break cancels operations it created and observes outstanding tasks without waiting forever for uncooperative parser code. Registry disposal still owns parser draining.

collectStream(chunks, encoder?, options?) is for consumers that actually need one complete result; it retains the whole output. Signal defaults to omission, empty defaults to text (returning ['text', ''] for an empty stream), the other empty policy is reject, and context defaults to stream. All-text data joins as text. A single byte chunk can return directly; multiple chunks with any bytes require an explicit encoder, even when all are bytes. Without it, ENV_UNSUPPORTED is raised; core does not read a global TextEncoder. Value chunks always produce INVALID_CHUNK. Malformed tuples retain chunkIndex and accumulated bytesConsumed, source iteration failures become ENCODE_FAILED, and abort preserves cancellation identity with iterator cleanup handled at its boundary.

bytesToBase64(Uint8Array) returns complete RFC 4648 Base64. base64ToBytes(string) requires canonical padding and valid unused trailing bits. Invalid input produces TypeError/INVALID_OPTION whose cause retains the original utils INVALID_ENCODING failure. This differs from unpadded base64url used by portable tags.

streamBase64Chunks(bytes) is a lazy synchronous Generator, yielding pieces without assembling one full string. Empty input yields none. Its internal block length is 32763 bytes, divisible by three so padding cannot corrupt an intermediate boundary; block size is not an option. Algorithms come from utils/bytes without constructing a whole binary string or using btoa/atob. Use bytesToBase64 when the destination requires one string, and keep bytes as bytes when the destination supports them. The 4/3 size expansion is a format property, not a performance measurement.

`ICodec<TValue, TEncoded, TId, TVersion>` has read-only id, version, encodedType, encode and decode. Encode/decode are function properties preserving strict parameter variance. TId defaults to string and TVersion to number. encodedType is unknown/string/uint8array. A synchronous codec is a different contract from an asynchronous registry parser. identityCodec fixes id=identity, version=1 and encodedType=unknown; both functions preserve the exact value and concrete type. The old alias and unversioned identity entry are removed.

defineJsonCodec, defineMessagePackCodec and defineCBORCodec require a positive safe-integer options.version and return frozen codecs. IDs are json, message-pack and cbor; outputs are string, Uint8Array and Uint8Array respectively. All three use the same portable projection/validation. JSON, collections JSON, CBOR and MessagePack project fields in Object.keys enumeration order without comparison sorting; getters run once in that order. MessagePack uses no extensions. CBOR disables records and host extensions, converting decoded bigint integers to numbers only when they are exact safe integers; otherwise it rejects.

defineProtobufCodec requires version, schema and binding. schema.id matches /^[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$/u and schema.version is a positive safe integer independent of codec.version. Binding must be a generated Buf DescMessage rather than custom encode/decode hooks. The returned schema identity is frozen, values use `MessageShape<TBinding>`, and encodedType is uint8array. Encode/decode validate genuine Uint8Array data and preserve original Buf failure causes. Factories provide no storage or network envelope.

ICodecValue’s static domain contains null, boolean, number, string, nested read-only arrays and records; finite numbers still require runtime checks. normalizeCodecFailure(error, code, message) preserves errors already owned by serialize and wraps other failures in TypeError with cause. CodecErrorText owns stable version, schema, encoding, decoding and portable-rejection diagnostics.

sections.heading: Portable defaults and the reusable walker

blocks.text: toPortableValue(value, active?) is the legacy intermediate projection rather than a final assertion. It follows Object.keys property enumeration order and recursively produces mutable ordinary objects without freezing. Uint8Array becomes { $rpc: 'bytes', base64url }. Inherited, nonenumerable and symbol record fields are omitted. Getters may run. Repeated sibling references are copied independently, while cycles are checked on the active ancestor path. Projection can temporarily retain undefined/NaN; codecs reject them during final portable validation.

assertPortableValue(value, active?) returns void. asCodecValue(value) validates and returns the same object narrowed to ICodecValue. Neither copies nor freezes. The default decoded profile rejects nonfinite numbers, undefined, functions, symbols, bigint, Date/Map/Set, invalid arrays and native bytes. Recognized byte tags retain the existing character-set checks rather than a different protocol’s stricter canonical-bit policy. Default depth is unlimited. Legacy projections of ArrayBuffer/class objects are not general-purpose safe snapshots.

Import createPortableWalker from root or codec, create it once per module/owner and reuse it. walk(value, active?, initialDepth?, beforeNativeBinary?) returns { value, byteUpperBound, hasBinary }; walk.value uses the same recursion but returns only the value. Active is the caller’s ancestor Set, otherwise created as needed for the call, with no retained graph afterward. Initial depth defaults to zero; the root is depth zero and only depth greater than maxDepth fails. The optional native-binary guard belongs to that invocation rather than global registration.

blocks.text: Context supplies reject, isAncestor, isUint8Array, bytesToBase64url, isCanonicalBase64url and optional beforeNativeBinary. Generic reasons include depth/cycle/access/ancestor; strategies own other reasons. Context is for synchronous hook use. Classified errors retain identity; application callback failures go through violation('access', original), and caller ancestor-Set failures retain their existing boundary.

byteUpperBound is a conservative JSON UTF-8 bound rather than an exact length: up to six escape bytes per UTF-16 unit, up to 32 per number, plus container punctuation and byte tags. Value, bound and hasBinary are fused in one traversal without rescanning the input. Strategies supply native lengths; this value is not a complete shared-backing/offset protocol budget.

IPortableBinaryResult is the unboxed union string/Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer. Borrowed native objects retain exact identity without copying/freezing. The second finish argument proves only native descendants; hasBinary also includes inline tags and grants no protocol permission. Reentrant getters restore outer accounting and active paths. Completed calls retain no caller graph, and the value-only array path does not add output-length observations.

Default JSON/MessagePack/CBOR remain inline-only with existing wire bytes and failure precedence: projection finishes before deferred validation fails, so a later getter failure can still take precedence. RPC’s null prototypes, freezing, parent-field capture, depth 64, canonical tags and protocol identities belong to rpc-contract strategies. Serialize embeds no consumer profile, manifest or native-negotiation owner.

emitOutput(value, format?) synchronously returns complete text. Format defaults to json, with yaml/toml alternatives. JSON reuses jsonParser. YAML/TOML are output-only without third-party runtimes, and are not registry parsers.

Inputs contain finite numbers, strings, booleans, arrays and plain own-data records. JSON/YAML accept null. Descriptor admission rejects enumerable accessors without evaluating them, along with cycles, sparse arrays, named array properties, enumerable symbols, unsupported values and nonplain prototypes. No toJSON, replacer or business getter is invoked. Failure returns no partial string and diagnostics do not echo input.

TOML requires a record root and rejects null at every depth as well as unpaired surrogates. Keys/strings are quoted and nested collections retain their shapes. Negative zero becomes -0.0; unsafe integers use floating-point spelling instead of the TOML integer domain. Failures are tagged native TypeError/INVALID_OPTION with read failures retained as causes. These strict own-data rules differ from legacy portable projection.

SerializeCodecError(message, details) requires code, type, phase, chunkIndex and bytesConsumed, with optional context, source and cause. Source defaults to serialization and TCode to ISerializeErrorCode; consumers can reuse the class with their own code union/source. Phase is encode/decode and cause retains the original object. Codec failures and native construction/lifecycle failures use different carriers, so branch on (source, code) rather than instanceof alone.

rows: REGISTRY_DISPOSED: new work after close/dispose, tagged Error.
CODEC_NOT_FOUND: unregistered format, SerializeCodecError with context=registry.
ENCODE_FAILED: encoding, empty output or stream iteration failure, retaining cause.
DECODE_FAILED: parsing or frame decoding fails.
INVALID_CHUNK: invalid tuple/label/data, mixed value output or value-to-wire conversion.
ABORTED: cooperative cancellation; SerializeCodecError or tagged native error depending on the boundary.
INVALID_OPTION: invalid plugin, version, portable input, scheduler, stream option, Base64 or output admission.
ENV_UNSUPPORTED: required host capabilities such as Encoding are unavailable.
TAG_MISSING: raw input has no explicit untagged reader.
TAG_INVALID: reserved header is malformed; no fallback.
TAG_UNKNOWN: valid tag has no registered codec revision.

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) returns the original error with read-only source/code. Omitted context stays absent. Repeating the same identity is idempotent, with context filled only once. Identity conflicts delegate to utils and throw (foundation.utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT), retaining the original error on cause instead of silently overwriting ownership.

ISerializeTaggedError adds source/code/context to a native error type. ISerializeTypeError and ISerializeRangeError retain their native types; ISerializeLifecycleError also permits errors. createSerializeError, createSerializeTypeError and createSerializeRangeError create coded native Error/TypeError/RangeError. Code/message are required. Options default to omission and permit cause/context; the ordinary Error also permits a frozen errors snapshot. Codes are public API, and error factories never rewrite stack. Empty output reports zero progress. Malformed decode chunks report zero progress, while parser decode failures report that chunk’s byte count. Stream wrappers use outer frame positions without losing inner causes.

For value-to-wire or mixed-value failures, return to the business value rather than forcing a representation. For CODEC_NOT_FOUND inspect types and the saved type tag. REGISTRY_DISPOSED requires a new registry. Multi-chunk byte collection requires an explicit encoder. If exports still block, inspect initial slice size, bounds and yieldTo; slicing is not preemptive termination.

A complete workflow creates the registry, encodes independent frames into the real sink, decodes them individually at the receiver, reads old formats using saved type tags and writes the default primaryType. Apply UTF-8/Base64 only at an actual text boundary, then await dispose. A configured deadline limits draining only. module scripts provide fmt, lint, typecheck, typecheck:test, test and a separate build; unverified historical measurements are not performance claims.

sections.heading: Preserve Map and Set in JSON

blocks.text: Use the collection codec explicitly when values contain Map or Set. It shares the strict portable profile with JSON, adds recursive collections, projects enumerable class fields, and rejects nonfinite numbers, undefined, Date and cycles. Reserved $rpc records must have the exact bytes/map/set shape. Collection iteration preserves insertion order and uses intrinsic slots and iterators. Bytes remain bytes records after decoding; old collection tuples are ordinary data.

Format codecs and public toPortableValue both follow integer-index enumeration followed by string insertion order, including getter traversal. serialize does not sort keys; consumers own any required canonical ordering. RPC owned snapshots and ordinary object and byte JSON paths preserve each object's own key order. The existing private RPC snapshot owner still copies and computes the byte upper bound in one traversal, skipping already encoded binary subtrees.

sections.heading: Carry a format tag in the encoded value

blocks.text: The first codec writes new values; every listed id/version can read its own tagged payload. An optional untagged codec only reads raw legacy values. Unknown tags fail with TAG_UNKNOWN; malformed reserved headers fail with TAG_INVALID and never fall back. A raw text value starting with mgt1: is interpreted as tagged input, even when it was produced by the untagged codec.

String carriers prepend mgt1:<id>@<version>;. Byte carriers prepend 00 4d 47 54, framing byte 01, a two-byte big-endian UTF-8 tag length and the tag. Unknown carriers return a frozen object with own $migaia.codec and value fields; the inner value stays unfrozen. All codecs must declare the same carrier. The framing identity is tagged@1; it is separate from storage envelope versions. ICodecEncodedType, ITaggedCodecOptions, ITaggedEncoded, ITaggedValue and ITaggedCodec preserve carrier and business-value inference.

sections.heading: Encode settings and read them back

blocks.text: A settings screen needs a text representation for saving and the same decoding path when it opens again.
Scattering stringify and parse calls across callers couples them to one format and leaves format selection and parser cleanup without a single owner.

Register `jsonPlugin()` in a serialize registry. Its first plugin chooses default writes; `encode()` returns a tagged chunk and `decode()` reads it. Use `chunkToText()` when a text channel needs the payload, then dispose the registry.

The required plugin list contains only jsonPlugin(), making primaryType json. Omitted registry options use systemScheduler, host Encoding capabilities, cleanup policy throw and no-op diagnostic callbacks. Operation type defaults to the primary format, context to anonymous and signal to omission. chunkToText requires its second TextDecoder argument. theme is application data rather than a serializer option.
Output:
Prints `format: json`, `text: {"theme":"dark"}`, then `theme: dark`.

The same registered parser handles encoding and decoding. A chunk is only `[kind, payload]`, not a stored envelope containing the format tag; keep `primaryType` beside persisted data when several formats coexist. The registry owns parser cleanup and must be disposed.

sections.heading: Write a new format while retaining an explicit old reader

blocks.text: New settings should omit a local preview cache, but existing saved settings still use the old format tag and must remain readable.
Replacing the only parser can strand old records. Guessing a format from `[kind, payload]` also fails because the chunk does not carry the application’s format tag.

Register the new parser first and keep the old parser under its saved tag. New writes use the first type by default; pass the stored `type` explicitly to `decode()` for old data. Both formats use JSON: the new writer omits `localCache`, while the old reader revives a stored numeric theme of 0 as `light`.

Each plugin contains type and parser. The first type, json-v2, handles default writes; json-v1 is selected explicitly by decode’s type. The new parser replacer receives key/value and returns undefined for localCache. The old reviver maps numeric theme 0 back to light, proving that its reader was selected. Space/decoder are omitted. saved.type is separate application metadata; the chunk’s text label describes representation, not format version.
Output:

blocks.code:
new format: json-v2
new text: {"theme":"dark"}
old theme: light
old cache: legacy

blocks.text: Prints `new format: json-v2`, `new text: {"theme":"dark"}`, `old theme: light`, then `old cache: legacy`.

The default writer changed without removing the old reader. Passing the saved old tag selects its reviver, which changes the stored 0 into `light`; using the new reader would leave 0 unchanged. Registered type strings are application envelope metadata; codec factory `version` fields are a separate contract. The JSON plugin follows native replacer/reviver behavior rather than the stricter portable codec profile.

sections.heading: Reject a nonfinite count instead of saving null

blocks.text: A measurement containing `NaN` is saved as `null`, and a later reader cannot distinguish invalid input from an intentionally empty value.
Native JSON replaces nonfinite numbers with null. Checking only the TypeScript number type does not reject `NaN`, so the original value can be lost without a failure.

Create `defineJsonCodec({ version: 1 })` and encode through its portable profile, a restricted cross-format data domain. Finite numbers pass; nonfinite numbers fail with `INVALID_OPTION` instead of being silently replaced.

The required options.version is 1 here and accepts positive safe integers. The codec returns id=json and encodedType=string. A TypeScript number can still be NaN, which the portable runtime rule rejects. Factory version metadata is not automatically embedded in the encoded string.
Output:
Prints `finite: {"count":2}`, `native JSON: {"count":null}`, then `portable failure: INVALID_OPTION`.

The codec rejects this lossy scalar conversion. Its required version is a positive safe integer and is metadata on the codec, not automatically embedded in the returned string. This strict profile differs from `jsonPlugin()`, which intentionally retains native JSON behavior.

sections.heading: Export the same configuration in three text formats

blocks.text: A configuration download needs JSON, YAML and TOML, but separate emitters accept different values and produce inconsistent representations of the same settings.
Handwritten formatting mixes value validation with quoting and nested collection syntax. Adding a format can accidentally change which fields survive or how strings are escaped.

Pass the configuration to `emitOutput()` and select `SerializeTextFormat`. All formats share the same plain-data admission rules; each call projects the input before emitting its selected format. Omitting the format selects JSON.

emitOutput takes plain own-data input and an optional format defaulting to json. SerializeTextFormat.yaml/toml select the other outputs; the complete format domain is json/yaml/toml. theme and retries are business fields. YAML/TOML emission supplies no reverse parser.

blocks.code:
import { emitOutput, SerializeTextFormat } from '@migaia/serialize'

const settings = { theme: 'dark', retries: 2 }
console.log('JSON:', emitOutput(settings))
console.log('YAML:', emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.yaml))
console.log('TOML:\n' + emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.toml))

blocks.text: Output:
Prints `JSON: {"theme":"dark","retries":2}`, `YAML: {"theme": "dark", "retries": 2}`, then three lines: `TOML:`, `"theme" = "dark"`, `"retries" = 2`.

All three outputs retain the supplied fields, and YAML uses valid flow syntax. This is text emission, not a YAML/TOML parser. TOML requires a root record and rejects null; other formats also reject unsupported values rather than silently omitting them.

sections.heading: Reject an accessor without evaluating it

blocks.text: A configuration object contains a getter that exposes data or performs work when serialization reads the property.
Ordinary property access during copying or stringify executes that getter. Deleting the field only after it has been read cannot undo the work or the exposure.

Use `emitOutput()` for a plain-data export boundary. It inspects own enumerable property descriptors first and rejects accessors before evaluating their getter; valid data is projected before text is produced.

No extra options are used; omitted format still selects json. token is an accessor business field rejected during descriptor admission. The reads counter proves its getter was never called. Proxy descriptor traps may still execute, so this is not a promise that no user code can run.
Output:

blocks.code:
rejected: true INVALID_OPTION
getter reads: 0

blocks.text: Prints `rejected: true INVALID_OPTION`, then `getter reads: 0`.

This accessor is rejected without executing its getter, and no partial string is returned. The boundary accepts plain records or dense arrays containing supported scalar/data values; it is not a general object serializer and does not promise to avoid Proxy traps while inspecting descriptors.

sections.heading: Process independent array slices without joining JSON documents

blocks.text: A large export is encoded into one full array string before its first piece can be processed, retaining the complete encoded document in memory.

Splitting an array is not enough if the caller later concatenates the JSON strings: `[1,2]` followed by `[3,4]` is two documents, not one JSON array. The stream needs a receiver that understands each slice as its own frame.

This standalone example directly imports the scheduler, so install `@migaia/utils` alongside `@migaia/serialize`. Use `encodeStream()` with the registry and a scheduler, then consume each emitted chunk separately. Fixed slice bounds make this example produce two items per slice; `maxInFlight: 1` waits for each encoded slice before admitting the next.

encodeStream requires registry, items and options.scheduler. systemScheduler provides now/schedule. minItems, maxItems and initialItems are all 2, with maxInFlight 1. Omitted targetMs is 8, type uses the primary format, context is stream, signal is absent and yieldTo uses a zero-delay scheduled task. A final slice shorter than two items is valid; finally disposes the registry.
This example imports @migaia/utils/scheduler directly. Add that dependency explicitly to the consuming project:

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/utils

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
frame: [1,2]
frame: [3,4]
frame: [5]

blocks.text: Prints `frame: [1,2]`, `frame: [3,4]`, then `frame: [5]`.

Each chunk contains one independently encoded slice in input order. Consume them as frames; this API does not assemble a single document or serialize each item as one continuous JSON array. The default `maxInFlight` is 1; higher values overlap requests but retain more in-flight data, and an early consumer return cancels queued operations without forcibly interrupting parser code.

This module owns value representations, chunks, formats and codec lifecycles. Storage, Worker, HTTP and SSR hosts belong to consumers. The root combines core, plugins and registry, and adds format constants, emitOutput, createPortableWalker and codec-related types.

ISerializeChunk is a read-only pair: text carries a string, bytes carries Uint8Array, and value carries an already-completed unknown business value. Text and bytes have wire representations; value has no implicit text or byte form. ISerializeChunkKind is the union of those three labels.

ISerializeParser requires name, encode(value, context) and decode(chunk, context), with optional dispose(). Encode can return a chunk, a Promise of one chunk, a synchronous Iterable or an AsyncIterable. Decode returns a value or Promise. ISerializeOutput names that four-way encoding-output union. A synchronous parser can return directly without creating its own Promise. ISerializeContext contains the composed signal and diagnostic context string. The field is context rather than the old source name, keeping it distinct from error ownership. ISerializePlugin pairs type with parser.

registry.encode collects one parser output into one chunk. All-text chunks join as text. Once bytes appear, text is encoded and the output is assembled as bytes. A value chunk must be the only output: combining it with anything produces INVALID_CHUNK. Zero chunks produce ENCODE_FAILED. Incremental admission records actual chunkIndex and bytesConsumed and checks cancellation before consumption. Failed async iteration invokes iterator.return; secondary cleanup failures go to report without replacing the primary failure.

isChunkShape distinguishes a single chunk from a chunk container: it requires an array of length two whose first item is a string. It does not validate the label. Later validation distinguishes unknown labels, non-string text data and non-Uint8Array bytes. Boundary tuple fields are captured facts rather than values to reinterpret through repeated later reads.

Root constants and value unions use canonical domains: SerializeChunkKind/ISerializeChunkKind are text/bytes/value; SerializeOutput/ISerializeOutputFormat are text/structured/binary; SerializeTextFormat/ISerializeTextFormat are json/yaml/toml; SerializePhase/ISerializePhase are encode/decode; SerializeCleanupPolicy/ISerializeCleanupPolicy are throw/report; SerializeCleanupKind/ISerializeCleanupKind are cleanup-error/drain-timeout; SerializePluginType/ISerializePluginType are json. These labels neither emit instrumentation events nor introduce error codes.

createSerializeRegistry(plugins, options?) requires a nonempty plugin array. The first type becomes primaryType. Each type is an ASCII token of 1–64 characters, starting with a letter/digit and continuing with letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN is /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i. assertSerializeType rejects invalid tokens with RangeError/INVALID_OPTION. HTML and archive-envelope writers still need correct escaping; token validation is not output escaping.

Types must be unique. Each parser needs callable encode/decode, and dispose must be callable when supplied. Empty lists and duplicate types produce RangeError/INVALID_OPTION; malformed structures produce TypeError/INVALID_OPTION. Plugin lists, fields and methods are admitted before ownership transfers. Later input mutation cannot replace captured behavior. Failed admission invokes neither parser work nor parser cleanup and creates no partially owned parser set to roll back. Options default to an empty object and must be an object or function when supplied.

Core timer use does not read global timer functions.

primaryType is the first format. types lists registered types in order; has(type) checks membership. encode(value, options?) and decode(chunk, options?) return Promises. Operation type defaults to primaryType, context to anonymous and signal to omission. The parser receives a composition of caller and internal closing signals: the first observed cancellation wins. Unknown formats produce CODEC_NOT_FOUND with context fixed to registry. ISerializeRegistry names the returned interface and ISerializeRegistryOptions the construction options.

Decode first checks closing, then finds the requested format, then validates the chunk. The corresponding failure priority is REGISTRY_DISPOSED, CODEC_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_CHUNK. Closed-registry failures are tagged native Errors rather than necessarily SerializeCodecError instances. Even if a parser ignores signal, the framework rejects on cancellation and discards late output; that does not forcibly terminate synchronous computation or an external task.

close() is synchronous and idempotent: it denies new operations and aborts current ones without disposing parsers. dispose(options?) closes first, drains, then awaits each parser disposer. Sharing one parser under several types still disposes that instance once. Repeated dispose calls return the first Promise by identity.

The sole disposal option deadlineAt defaults to undefined. A supplied value must be a finite absolute time in the scheduler.now clock domain. The first admitted call fixes it; later calls cannot replace it. The deadline bounds draining, not parser cleanup. If the deadline is already past or expires while waiting, onDrainTimeout can receive { kind: 'drain-timeout', source, deadlineAt, pendingCount } before cleanup continues. pendingCount can be zero. A drain timeout is a diagnostic event rather than a new error code. ISerializeTimeoutDiagnostic describes it; ISerializeCleanupError describes cleanup-failure events.

Signal state is rechecked immediately after listener registration without depending on host event replay. An already-closing internal signal takes precedence at entry. Cancellation causes retain identity, and failing signal reads produce INVALID_OPTION. Public Promises can reject promptly while registry still tracks the underlying parser task; close itself does not wait.

With cleanup.policy throw, cleanup failure rejects disposal. If another primary failure already exists, secondary failures stay in errors, using AggregateError when necessary to retain all originals. Report policy emits { kind: 'cleanup-error', source, error } while allowing normal settlement. Diagnostic callback failures cannot rewrite an already-published result; report failures reach the shared utils host-error path. Detached task failures remain observed without rejoining a closed lifecycle. Omitting report retains the existing no-op policy.

jsonParser(options?) returns a parser named json; jsonPlugin(options?) returns a plugin of type json. IJsonPluginOptions replacer, reviver and space default to omission and feed JSON.stringify, JSON.parse and indentation respectively. The optional byte decoder falls back to the host TextDecoder. Options default to an empty object. Native JSON semantics are distinct from strict portable codec validation.

Encode returns text and rejects when stringify returns undefined. Native encoding failures receive ENCODE_FAILED. Decode returns value payloads unchanged, parses text directly and decodes bytes before parsing. Missing decoding capability produces ENV_UNSUPPORTED; parse failures receive DECODE_FAILED. A standalone parser also provides error identity. Annotatable native errors retain instance, type and stack; conflicting or non-extensible errors are retained as the cause of a coded TypeError wrapper.

chunkToText(chunk, decoder) and chunkToBytes(chunk, encoder) require their Encoding argument. The former returns text unchanged or decodes bytes. The latter encodes text or returns a slice copy of bytes, without sharing the original array. Both reject value chunks with TypeError/INVALID_CHUNK. Conversion failures are tagged at the decode/encode boundary with their causes retained.

sliceByFrameBudget(items, options) is an async generator over a read-only array. Options and scheduler are required; core provides no default global timer. On resumption after yield, it observes the consumer’s slice-processing time, estimates a next size using targetMs / max(elapsed, 0.05), averages that estimate with the current size and clamps to minItems/maxItems. This is cooperative slicing rather than a frame-rate guarantee on every device. IFrameBudgetOptions names slicing options, IEncodeStreamOptions adds encoding settings, and ICollectStreamOptions names collection policy. A custom yieldTo owns its Promise and cancellation behavior; its wait is not guaranteed to abort promptly.

Stream entry points capture options before acquiring an iterator, so admission failures are not mislabeled as iteration failures. Cancellation is rechecked across async boundaries. Signal defaults to omission, empty defaults to text (returning ['text', ''] for an empty stream), the other empty policy is reject, and context defaults to stream. All-text data joins as text. bytesToBase64(Uint8Array) returns complete RFC 4648 Base64. base64ToBytes(string) requires canonical padding and valid unused trailing bits. `ICodec<TValue, TEncoded, TId, TVersion>` has read-only id, version, encodedType, encode and decode. Encode/decode are function properties preserving strict parameter variance. TId defaults to string and TVersion to number. encodedType is unknown/string/uint8array. A synchronous codec is a different contract from an asynchronous registry parser. identityCodec fixes id=identity, version=1 and encodedType=unknown; both functions preserve the exact value and concrete type. defineJsonCodec, defineMessagePackCodec and defineCBORCodec require a positive safe-integer options.version and return frozen codecs. IDs are json, message-pack and cbor; outputs are string, Uint8Array and Uint8Array respectively. All three use the same portable projection/validation. JSON, collections JSON, CBOR and MessagePack project fields in Object.keys enumeration order without comparison sorting; getters run once in that order. MessagePack uses no extensions. CBOR disables records and host extensions, converting decoded bigint integers to numbers only when they are exact safe integers; otherwise it rejects.

defineProtobufCodec requires version, schema and binding. schema.id matches /^[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$/u and schema.version is a positive safe integer independent of codec.version. emitOutput(value, format?) synchronously returns complete text. Format defaults to json, with yaml/toml alternatives. JSON reuses jsonParser. YAML/TOML are output-only without third-party runtimes, and are not registry parsers.

Inputs contain finite numbers, strings, booleans, arrays and plain own-data records. JSON/YAML accept null. Descriptor admission rejects enumerable accessors without evaluating them, along with cycles, sparse arrays, named array properties, enumerable symbols, unsupported values and nonplain prototypes. No toJSON, replacer or business getter is invoked. Failure returns no partial string and diagnostics do not echo input.

TOML requires a record root and rejects null at every depth as well as unpaired surrogates. Keys/strings are quoted and nested collections retain their shapes. Negative zero becomes -0.0; unsafe integers use floating-point spelling instead of the TOML integer domain. Failures are tagged native TypeError/INVALID_OPTION with read failures retained as causes. These strict own-data rules differ from legacy portable projection.

SerializeCodecError(message, details) requires code, type, phase, chunkIndex and bytesConsumed, with optional context, source and cause. Source defaults to serialization and TCode to ISerializeErrorCode; consumers can reuse the class with their own code union/source. Phase is encode/decode and cause retains the original object. Codec failures and native construction/lifecycle failures use different carriers, so branch on (source, code) rather than instanceof alone.

rows: REGISTRY_DISPOSED: new work after close/dispose, tagged Error.
CODEC_NOT_FOUND: unregistered format, SerializeCodecError with context=registry.
ENCODE_FAILED: encoding, empty output or stream iteration failure, retaining cause.
DECODE_FAILED: parsing or frame decoding fails.
INVALID_CHUNK: invalid tuple/label/data, mixed value output or value-to-wire conversion.
ABORTED: cooperative cancellation; SerializeCodecError or tagged native error depending on the boundary.
INVALID_OPTION: invalid plugin, version, portable input, scheduler, stream option, Base64 or output admission.
ENV_UNSUPPORTED: required host capabilities such as Encoding are unavailable.
TAG_MISSING: raw input has no explicit untagged reader.
TAG_INVALID: reserved header is malformed; no fallback.
TAG_UNKNOWN: valid tag has no registered codec revision.

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) returns the original error with read-only source/code. Omitted context stays absent. Repeating the same identity is idempotent, with context filled only once. Identity conflicts delegate to utils and throw (foundation.utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT), retaining the original error on cause instead of silently overwriting ownership.

ISerializeTaggedError adds source/code/context to a native error type. ISerializeTypeError and ISerializeRangeError retain their native types; ISerializeLifecycleError also permits errors. createSerializeError, createSerializeTypeError and createSerializeRangeError create coded native Error/TypeError/RangeError. Code/message are required. Options default to omission and permit cause/context; the ordinary Error also permits a frozen errors snapshot. Codes are public API, and error factories never rewrite stack. Empty output reports zero progress. Malformed decode chunks report zero progress, while parser decode failures report that chunk’s byte count. Stream wrappers use outer frame positions without losing inner causes.

For value-to-wire or mixed-value failures, return to the business value rather than forcing a representation. For CODEC_NOT_FOUND inspect types and the saved type tag. REGISTRY_DISPOSED requires a new registry. Multi-chunk byte collection requires an explicit encoder. If exports still block, inspect initial slice size, bounds and yieldTo; slicing is not preemptive termination.

A complete workflow creates the registry, encodes independent frames into the real sink, decodes them individually at the receiver, reads old formats using saved type tags and writes the default primaryType. Apply UTF-8/Base64 only at an actual text boundary, then await dispose. A configured deadline limits draining only. module scripts provide fmt, lint, typecheck, typecheck:test, test and a separate build; unverified historical measurements are not performance claims.

sections.heading: Preserve Map and Set in JSON

blocks.text: Use the collection codec explicitly when values contain Map or Set. It shares the strict portable profile with JSON, adds recursive collections, projects enumerable class fields, and rejects nonfinite numbers, undefined, Date and cycles. Reserved $rpc records must have the exact bytes/map/set shape. Collection iteration preserves insertion order and uses intrinsic slots and iterators. Bytes remain bytes records after decoding; old collection tuples are ordinary data.

Format codecs and public toPortableValue both follow integer-index enumeration followed by string insertion order, including getter traversal. serialize does not sort keys; consumers own any required canonical ordering. RPC owned snapshots and ordinary object and byte JSON paths preserve each object's own key order. The existing private RPC snapshot owner still copies and computes the byte upper bound in one traversal, skipping already encoded binary subtrees.

sections.heading: Carry a format tag in the encoded value

blocks.text: The first codec writes new values; every listed id/version can read its own tagged payload. An optional untagged codec only reads raw legacy values. Unknown tags fail with TAG_UNKNOWN; malformed reserved headers fail with TAG_INVALID and never fall back. A raw text value starting with mgt1: is interpreted as tagged input, even when it was produced by the untagged codec.

String carriers prepend mgt1:<id>@<version>;. Byte carriers prepend 00 4d 47 54, framing byte 01, a two-byte big-endian UTF-8 tag length and the tag. Unknown carriers return a frozen object with own $migaia.codec and value fields; the inner value stays unfrozen. All codecs must declare the same carrier. The framing identity is tagged@1; it is separate from storage envelope versions. ICodecEncodedType, ITaggedCodecOptions, ITaggedEncoded, ITaggedValue and ITaggedCodec preserve carrier and business-value inference.

symbols.purpose: Creates a registry owning a nonempty plugin set and parser cleanup. The first plugin selects default writes and reads; types and methods are captured at construction and duplicate types reject. Chunks carry only kind and payload, so older formats must be selected using their separately stored `type`. The migration case uses JSON parser options `replacer` and `reviver`: both receive the current property key (including an empty root key) and value, synchronously return its replacement, and default to `undefined`. The old reader maps numeric theme 0 to light through its reviver; `space` defaults to undefined (compact output), and `decoder` defaults to a host TextDecoder when bytes are decoded. plugins: Required nonempty ordered `ISerializePlugin` array. Every descriptor requires unique `type` matching `/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i` and `parser`.
